name: RC-B10-0482/2026 – After § 9 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 9b. Insists that the only lasting solution to the threats to human life and regional stability is an immediate ceasefire and a just and lasting peace, negotiated in accordance with the UN Charter and international law; calls for the EU to finally assume an active role as a mediator and to support all diplomatic efforts in this direction instead of pursuing the logic of military escalation;
